source_row.rationale: Even with the correct PPE available, improper donning or doffing technique can result in self-contamination (such as touching a contaminated surface with bare skin during glove/gown removal), increasing infection transmission risk. Periodic hands-on training and competency validation help ensure staff can correctly and consistently perform these critical safety procedures.
source_row.source_detail: Doffing must avoid self-contamination; training and demonstrated correct technique are core safety practices; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.stem: A hospital requires staff to demonstrate competency in proper PPE donning and doffing technique through periodic hands-on training and validation, and a veteran staff member questions why this is needed since they already know how to put gloves and a gown on.
